sample_unit: questions (each posed to 5 LLMs, responses rated by 2 experts)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM patient-education responses (SMOG, Flesch reading ease) across five models
links.effect: Claude 3.7 Sonnet achieved the highest readability scores (p < 0.001); the other models scored lower. Absolute reading grade levels are not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: This model provided reader-friendly content using simpler and more comprehensible sentence structures.

screen.reason: The study empirically compares the performance (accuracy, completeness, readability) of five LLMs responding to standardized preoperative patient education questions for mitral valve surgery, evaluated by expert clinicians and readability formulas.
